display: SunFounder TS-7 7" HDMI touch display (1024 × 600 IPS)
mount: normal (IPS: no need to turn it upside down)

display_mount.screws: 4× M3 × 6 from behind, through the ears into the bezel's bosses
display_mount.cable_slot: 12 × 20 mm in the plate, 76.2-88.7 mm right of centre, 43-63 mm up: the HDMI flat cable and the micro-USB lead go through it into the pocket, then into the box through the slot above the USB window

viewer_frame.rule: every asm_*.stl: this frame moved by (-x, -y, -z_mid), then turned 180° about Y (PCB centre at the origin, its parts up)

pcb_constraints.outline: 100 × 100 mm, parts face the lid, 4× M3 on 92 × 92 into the posts
pcb_constraints.fan_zone: 32 × 32 mm centred at template [45.0, 46.0] (mm from the top-left, parts side up): parts ≤ 6 mm
pcb_constraints.sma_strip: 14 mm into the board × 12 mm along the edge, on the edge away from the Pi's ports, centred 34.5 mm below the board's top edge: no parts
pcb_constraints.corners: 10 × 10 mm round each mounting hole: no through-hole pins (posts and ribs underneath)

hardware.display_to_bezel: 4× M3 × 6 pan or button head, from behind through the display's ears
hardware.bezel_to_plate: 6× M3 × 10 from the back of the plate into 2.6 mm pilots
hardware.fan: 30 mm 5 V fan from the black Pi case, 4× M3 × 16 + nuts, blowing OUT through the lid
hardware.amps: 4× M4 nuts in the bottom bosses, M4 × 10 (RAM-B-202U round base, or a car bracket)
hardware.piezo: pressed into the 3 fingers on the bezel's skin (face on their 2 mm ledges), a dab of RTV on each; leads up the right cavity and out through the plate's slot
hardware.usb_wing: 2× M3 × 10 socket cap from inside the bezel's right cavity (before the display goes in), VHB on its back to the trim
hardware.usb_passthrough: its own nut, held by the wing: turn the socket from outside to tighten

buzzer.part: 12 V active piezo Ø23.2 × 12 mm (MEASURE yours)
buzzer.where: in the bezel's right cavity below the display's plugs, centre [87.38, -16.6] mm (right of / above the bezel's centre), held by 3 fingers on the skin
buzzer.fires_through: 5 right intake slots (148 mm² open), 2.0 mm behind the bezel's skin
buzzer.wiring: the old alert-pod JST-GH on the carrier: + and - only; the button pins stay unused
buzzer.behaviour: blind-spot beeps auto-mute after 4 s (the side LED keeps flashing); a TPMS warning beeps twice, then only the screen shows it

usb_passthrough.hole: Ø25.8 mm, the v1 panel's cut (CFG.USB_HOLE_DIAMETER), in the wing's end wall
usb_passthrough.faces: the passenger side (+X), socket axis level, 43 mm above the bezel's centre line
usb_passthrough.cable: through the bezel's side wall (hidden by the wing), across the right cavity above the display's plugs, down through the plate's cable slot into the pocket, to the car's USB port
assembly: bezel face down: screw the wing on (2× M3 × 10 from inside the right cavity)
nut into the wing from its open back; from outside push the plug, cable and body through the hole and the nut; turn the socket until the collar is snug
plug and cable through the bezel's side opening, then through the plate's slot FIRST, before the display's leads
fit the display, then the plate
measure: socket body Ø and how far it stands out
body/boot length behind the panel up to where the cable leaves, and its Ø
nut across corners / flats and thickness
free flat trim right of the bezel's edge (≥ wing size) and anything in front of it

asm_bezel.label: Bezel: front frame, the display hangs on its 4 bosses; intake slots beside the screen; 3 fingers hold the piezo behind the right slots (print face down)

asm_housing.label: Housing: plate + rear box for the Pi and the PCB (print plate down)

asm_lid.label: Lid: 30 mm exhaust fan + cable exit (print outside face down)

asm_cables.label: HDMI flat-cable adapter and 90° micro-USB plug, rising to the plate's cable slot (dummy)

asm_pi.label: Raspberry Pi 4 with its plugs: micro-HDMI adapter, 90° USB-C, 90° UART (dummy)

asm_buzzer.label: 12 V active piezo, behind the right intake slots (dummy)

asm_usb_wing.label: USB wing: holds the car's USB passthrough beside the bezel, v1's Ø25.8 cut (print front face down)

asm_usb_pass.label: The v1 USB passthrough: socket facing right, nut held by the wing, cable into the pocket (dummy)

asm_wing_screws.label: 2× M3 × 10 from inside the bezel into the wing's tabs (dummy)
